description:
£175 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the market this spacious eight bedroom student property, ideally situated on Devonshire Place in the heart of Jesmond.

Perfectly located for student living, the property offers excellent access to local amenities and is conveniently positioned for both Newcastle University and Northumbria University. The popular Osborne Road is also within walking distance, offering a fantastic selection of bars, restaurants and cafés.

With its generous accommodation and sought-after location, this property is an ideal choice for students looking to enjoy everything Jesmond and Newcastle have to offer.

Student properties in this location are always in high demand, so don't miss out! Contact My Property Box today to arrange your viewing.
